Title: Retrosynthetic accessibility score
Description: Rates how likely a molecule is to be reachable by computer-aided retrosynthesis, expressed as a probability rather than a heuristic complexity count. Thakkar and colleagues generated the training labels by running a retrosynthesis planner over a large compound set and recording which targets it could solve, then fitted a fast classifier to reproduce that outcome without rerunning the search. The score therefore reflects what one particular planner and its reaction rules could achieve, not synthesisability in absolute terms.
Interpretation: Probability that a retrosynthesis planner can find a route to the molecule.
